notes: Modern-data pilot/full profiles for 2024. April 2024 is preferred for the initial clean-signal baseline because Qrator reported no global BGP incidents in April 2024, while Kentik documented a major global route leak on 2024-03-11.

profiles.description: Memory-safe first modern-traffic smoke test on a 60-minute April 2024 window.
profiles.selection_reason: Use a smaller first pilot after the 4-hour baseline event-build step hit the local memory boundary.

profiles.description: Initial 4-hour modern-traffic pilot on a low-cost April 2024 window.
profiles.selection_reason: Pilot-sized 2024 window for first modernity/scalability smoke test before any 24h replay.

profiles.description: S2-A 6-hour modern scalability and stability rerun using the same April 2024 low-incident window.
profiles.selection_reason: First post-S1F expansion step: long enough to test stability beyond the 60-minute pilot, short enough to bound local runtime before any 24h replay.

profiles.description: Full 24-hour modern-traffic replay using the same collector set and start time as the pilot.
profiles.selection_reason: Main S1-A full-day run after the 4h pilot is stable.
